quantLevels.label: Q4_K_M
quantLevels.description: 4-bit k-quant, medium — the usual default for consumer hardware: the smallest file most people would actually pick, at a quality cost most people cannot hear or read.

quantLevels.label: Q5_K_M
quantLevels.description: 5-bit k-quant, medium — a step closer to full precision for a moderately larger file.

quantLevels.label: Q8_0
quantLevels.description: 8-bit, near-lossless — close to FP16 output quality at roughly half the size.

quantLevels.label: FP16
quantLevels.description: Full half-precision weights. Not a quantization at all — the reference point the other three are traded off against.
